description_en: Prints a receipt based on a receipt printing template created in the Cloud Printing Service console
description_zh: 调用该接口根据寄雁传书服务控制台创建的小票打印模板完成小票打印
name: PrintByTemplate

parameters.example: {   "orderTable": [     {       "number": "1",       "price": "33.00",       "name": "糖醋排骨"     }   ],   "orderTime": "2021-01-25 10:20:00",   "address": "地址：浙江省杭州市西湖区阿里云飞天园区",   "phone": "13********",   "price": "? 74.00",   "distributionFee": "5.00",   "shopName": "XX食品商店",   "title": "XX外卖单",   "status": "--已在线支付--" }
parameters.help_en: The printing parameters. You can obtain the printing parameter template from the Cloud Printing Service console, and then fill in the content to be dynamically printed
parameters.help_zh: 打印参数，您可以在寄雁传书服务控制台获取打印参数的模板，然后在模板中填入本次需要动态打印的内容
parameters.name: params_json_string

parameters.help_en:
The device ID.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The template identifier. You can obtain the template identifier from the Cloud Printing Service console
parameters.help_zh: 模板标识，您可以在寄雁传书服务的控制台获取模板标识
parameters.name: template_biz_code

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the product.

If you specify ProductKey, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
产品的唯一标识。

如果传入ProductKey，则必须同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send a historical topic to the printing device.

false (default): The topic format sent to the device is /ext/rrpc/+/{pk}/{dn}/user/print.
true: The topic format sent to the device is /ext/rrpc/+/{pk}/{dn}/print
parameters.help_zh:
是否下发历史的Topic给打印设备。

false（默认）：下发设备的Topic格式为/ext/rrpc/+/{pk}/{dn}/user/print
true：下发设备的Topic格式为/ext/rrpc/+/{pk}/{dn}/print
parameters.name: history_print_topic

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

DeviceErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned by the printing device.

2: out of paper
3: paper jam
DeviceErrorCode.description_zh:
打印设备返回的错误码。

2：缺纸
3：卡纸

DeviceErrorMessage.description_en: The error details returned by the printing device
DeviceErrorMessage.description_zh: 打印设备返回的错误详情

Id.description_en: The ID of the print job

MaxRetryCount.description_en:
The maximum number of retries. The value is fixed to 2, which means a maximum of 2 retries.

After the print command is sent to the device, if the device responds with a failure or times out, the server resends the print command
MaxRetryCount.description_zh:
最多重试次数，固定取值为2，最多重试2次。

打印指令下发到设备后，如果设备回复失败或者超时，服务器将重新下发打印指令

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the printing is successful.

true: The printing is successful.

false: The printing fails
Success.description_zh:
是否打印成功。

true：打印成功。

false：打印失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
